# PhaseTransitionExistence

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The proven occurrence of a critical temperature below which the system exhibits long-range order despite disorder and frustration. Demonstrates that ordered computational states can persist in noisy, disordered interconnect fabrics, a key requirement for reliable TCC/iNEST operations.
